task: perf.Sudoku: bitmask Sudoku solver with parse validation, solve, capped countSolutions and isValidSolution
reasoning_summary: Row/column/box candidates are 9-bit ints; the solver picks the empty cell with the fewest candidates via Integer.bitCount and iterates candidates with x&-x. Search state is private to each call so the API is pure. Tests cover a known solution, a hard puzzle under a 2 s preemptive timeout, capped counting, invalid input and randomised blanked grids.
